jobs.description:
CE Driver Wanted for a Construction-Related Company in the Kluisbergen Region 
Your Profile: 

 
• * 
 You will start from the depot in Kluisbergen. 

 
• * You ensure the proper securing of walls, columns, and roof panels for safe transport. 
 
• * 
You drive the truck with a wall trailer or flatbed.

• * You contribute to the order and cleanliness of the truck. 

Your Schedule: 

 
• * 
 You work full-time from Monday to Friday.

Your Profile: 

 
• * You hold a CE driving license. 
 
• * 
You have a valid driver's card and code 95. 

 
• * 
You are flexible, punctual, and precise. 

 
• *

• * 
Experience is a plus!

Are you looking for a challenging job within one of the largest food groups in Belgium (pork meat)? Have you always been interested in pork processing and want the opportunity to learn how to debone a pig?                        

 Follow o  ur intensive training program and quickly develop the necessary skills. As a reward for your eagerness to learn, you will receive a permanent contract.                                                 
Wij bieden
Our offer:

• Permanent contract after 25 days of training!
• Competitive salary 
• A whole bunch of benefits! Think of daily fresh meals in our company restaurant, 25% discount on personal meat orders, fun family activities, Christmas gifts, ... In short, too many to mention! 
• Job security and growth opportunities! Wij vragen
We are looking for ambitious and eager-to-learn individuals who can start early (start at 4.55 AM) and are flexible in their schedules depending on the season. 

You should be comfortable working in a cold environment and have an affinity for the food industry (pork meat), along with the associated quality and hygiene standards. 

You must be physically capable of standing and working all day and place importance on workplace safety. 

Language is not a barrier; everyone has equal opportunities, whether you speak English, French, or Dutch.

Westvlees guarantees sustainable production of pork. Their mission is to provide a healthy and tasty solution for every consumer at every meal occasion. As an employer, they place great importance on innovation, service, and quality, while centering family values in the company, which are essential to its operations.

Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English, spoken and written.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

As a quality control associate, you will inspect incoming and outgoing goods. You will verify quantities, record data, and follow up on discrepancies in accordance with established procedures. If you identify damage, incorrect products, or incorrect quantities, you will report them and help find a solution. Your meticulous approach ensures that the quality of the goods and the logistics process are maintained.

 

• You work accurately and have an eye for detail

• You can work independently and take initiative when necessary

• You check and record figures quickly and accurately

• You communicate clearly in the event of damage, incorrect products, or discrepancies in quantities

• You can work according to established procedures

• You are available for a permanent late-shift position

• You are comfortable using a tablet

• You have a very good command of English, as communication with the team leader will be in English

Job description
Ready for a hands-on role in textile manufacturing? Join a two-shift all-round opportunity in Harelbeke. You’ll work with a team at a textile manufacturer producing doormats.

• 
Package doormats and follow the packaging schedule.

• 
Make sure pallets, labels, and customer-specific packaging materials are ready at the line.

• 
Set up packaging lines and work with the technician to resolve issues.

• 
Help keep the packaging area clean and orderly.

• 
Enter and adjust machine parameters, and follow production progress.

• 
Check product quality and ensure items are labelled and packaged correctly.

Resolve minor technical issues and help maintain an efficient process.

• 
Keep your work area clean, orderly and safe.

The working day starts from 07:00.

Very good English feels natural to you; Dutch is a welcome extra.

You bring an accurate, responsible and quality-focused approach to your work.

Flexibility comes easily: you’re open to changing working hours and overtime when needed.

• 
You live in Belgium, have a driving licence and your own transport, and are comfortable working in a temperature-controlled environment of 10–12°C.
